name: thermal_comfort_pmv_ppd
title: Thermal comfort: Fanger PMV-PPD model
summary: Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) and Predicted Percentage of Dissatisfied (PPD) after Fanger (1970): full body heat balance (breathing, perspiration, sweat, clothing, radiation, convection) with the activity and clothing selected from two embedded lookup tables.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution: 46 of 57 variables within 0.1 %, 51/57 within 0.5 %; the rest are 5 stale cells of a second run and property-driven deviations (humid-air formulation).
verification.reference: EES solution stored in the source file (57 variables); activity row 3, clothing row 2 (activite$ = 'Repos_debout', Veture$ = 'Ete')
verification.notes: 46/57 variables agree within 1e-3 (51/57 within 0.5%; mostly exact); the 5 EES-side overwritten cells (E_dot_m, Q_dot_m, M_dot_CO2, T_sk, H_dot_sweat) mix a second operating point into the stored panel (see README); largest consistent-subset deviation 5.2e-3 on w_R_ex (humid-air formulation). The comparison was made with the earlier numeric-selection variant, whose 57 variables the native file (LOOKUP$ROW, string-keyed tables) reproduces exactly (CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b).
